bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2021. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; extracted via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3), good quality with minor digit noise (e.g. 'Total liabilities' printed with a stray extra leading digit, corrected via the balance-sheet identity). Extensively cross-validated: the Mar-2021 comparative P&L column (investment income 69,178,130; profit paid on deposits -106,316,043; net investment income -37,137,913; total operating income -18,702,186; operating expenses 100,029,297; operating profit before provision -118,731,483; PBT -98,731,483; tax 525,683; PAT -99,257,166; EPS -0.15; NOCFPS 0.13) matches 2021_Q1.json's own figures exactly. As in every prior quarter, the source's 'Specific provision (charged)/released' line is printed as a plain positive number regardless of whether it is actually a charge or a recovery; the true sign is derived here as C minus the reported PBT (yielding -8.0m, a net recovery, for this quarter) rather than trusted at face value. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.13, all matching the filing's own printed EPS/NAVPS/NOCFPS Notes section).
